$comment: REDEVKIT managed entries for .claude/settings.json permissions.allow (D51). Read-only git (git hash-object only with --stdin, never -w), the project test runners and the optional audits. No git write, package install or deploy command is allowed. Not network-free: test entries run the project's own scripts, which may do anything those scripts do, and security_scan.py runs npm audit, which queries the npm registry.
